images.subject: Inside a huge open mining gallery carved into grey rock, a thick vein of gleaming silvery raw metal ore runs diagonally across the rock wall, freshly exposed by large far-future drilling machines.
images.detail: The silvery metal vein glints brightly under floodlights, and tiny miners in suits stand at its foot for scale.

images.subject: A small far-future colony of domes and towers on a grey rocky plain, seen from a distance under a violent solar storm: huge shimmering curtains of green and violet aurora and bright solar flares fill the sky.
images.detail: Arcs of blue electricity crackle along the colony's power lines and pylons.
images.mood: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, dramatic and ominous mood, dark stormy sky, harsh contrasting light with deep shadows, muted cold palette.

images.subject: A huge gutted far-future cruiser warship wreck slowly tumbling in orbit, its hull torn open, with cargo containers visible inside its open holds.
images.detail: Its damaged reactor leaks a glowing blue-green plume into space.
images.site: In space, in orbit around a grey cratered moon that fills the lower part of the frame, with the black sky full of stars above.
images.mood: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, tense and suspenseful mood, cold bluish light with strong contrast, deep shadows.

images.detail: The metallic vein reflects the floodlights like polished steel, clearly metal and not ice, and tiny miners in suits stand at its foot for scale.

images.subject: A huge geyser of heavy water erupts from the rocky ground next to a far-future deuterium synthesizer plant with a large pressure sphere: a tall column of white steam and glittering spray rises into the sky.
images.detail: Tiny vehicles hurry around its base, laying pipes to capture the jet.

images.subject: Ancient ruins of a vanished alien civilization, half-buried in the grey rock and freshly unearthed by a far-future excavation site: tall weathered monolithic arches and carved stone structures of a strange, non-human design.
images.detail: A soft glow of ancient technology shines from an open chamber at the centre of the ruins, lit by the excavation floodlights.

images.subject: A wide crater in the grey rock where dozens of huge boulders and rock slabs float motionless in mid-air above the crater floor, defying gravity, some of them several storeys high.
images.detail: Small far-future sensor masts and instruments stand around the crater rim, pointed at the floating rocks, and the light casts the shadows of the hovering boulders onto the ground below.

images.subject: A large abandoned far-future cargo freighter drifting silently in low orbit, intact but dark and lifeless, with its big cargo bay doors open and full of containers.
images.detail: Two small salvage shuttles with bright lights are docked at its open cargo bay, unloading containers, while a faint orange glow of the upper atmosphere starts to heat the underside of its hull.
images.site: In space, in low orbit just above a lifeless grey rocky planet whose curved horizon, with a thin bright rim of atmosphere, crosses the lower part of the frame, with the black sky full of stars above.
images.mood: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, hopeful mood, warm golden sunlight striking the hull with rich warm tones, crisp contrast.

images.subject: A large derelict far-future cargo freighter drifting alone and slowly tumbling in low orbit, clearly abandoned for a long time: dark unlit windows, a dented and scorched hull with missing panels, and loose cables trailing behind it.
images.detail: One of its big cargo bay doors hangs half open, revealing stacks of large cargo containers inside, and a few loose containers float out of the open bay into space.
images.site: In space, in low orbit just above a lifeless grey rocky planet whose curved horizon, with a thin bright rim of atmosphere, crosses the lower part of the frame, with the black sky full of stars above.
images.mood: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, hopeful mood, warm golden sunlight striking the hull with rich warm tones, crisp contrast.
images.view: Cinematic view with a centred composition: the subject sits in the middle of the frame, large and filling most of the frame height, with nothing important near the left or right edges. No person and no other ship anywhere in the image.

images.subject: A long derelict far-future space cargo hauler, built for space and not shaped like a boat: an open lattice spine frame carrying rows of large cargo containers clamped all along it, a small dark cockpit module at the front and a cluster of dead engine nozzles at the rear. It drifts alone and slowly tumbles in low orbit, clearly abandoned for a long time: dented and scorched hull plates, missing panels, dark unlit windows and loose cables trailing behind it.
images.detail: Its rows of cargo containers are still full and intact, a few of them knocked loose and floating beside the frame.
images.site: In space, in low orbit just above a lifeless grey rocky planet whose curved horizon, with a thin bright rim of atmosphere, crosses the lower part of the frame, with the black sky full of stars above.
images.mood: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, hopeful mood, warm golden sunlight striking the hull with rich warm tones, crisp contrast.
images.view: Cinematic view with a centred composition: the main element of the scene is placed in the middle of the frame, large and filling most of the frame height, with nothing important near the left or right edges, and no person in the foreground.

images.subject: The entrance of a far-future crystal mine gallery dug into a towering grey cliff has just collapsed: a huge pile of fallen rock and broken metal support beams blocks the tunnel mouth, with thick dust still billowing out of it.
images.detail: Shards of glowing pale blue crystal glint among the rubble, and tiny rescue vehicles with flashing orange lights stand at the foot of the rock pile.
images.mood: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, dramatic and ominous mood, dark stormy sky, harsh contrasting light with deep shadows, muted cold palette.

images.subject: A far-future construction site where a large high-tech building stands half-built: its tall metal scaffolding has been blown apart and partly collapsed, with twisted beams hanging down and a toppled construction crane lying across the site.
images.detail: Black scorch marks of explosive charges cover the broken scaffolding, with showers of sparks and small fires still burning among the wreckage.
images.mood: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, dramatic and ominous mood, dark stormy sky, harsh contrasting light with deep shadows, muted cold palette.
